q1.explanationZh: 全文都在讲唐宁街 10 号的猫 Larry：他怎么来的、做什么工作、有多受欢迎，所以主要介绍一只长期任职的捕鼠猫。

evidence.quote: Larry, the “Chief Mouser” of 10 Downing Street, isn’t going anywhere.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段最后一句说，当时的首相 David Cameron 和家人从动物救助中心挑了 Larry。

evidence.quote: The prime minister at the time, David Cameron, and his family chose him from an animal rescue centre.

q3.explanationZh: 前面说 Sybil 走后没有官方捕鼠猫，老鼠到处跑，人们才想要不要新猫来解决“这个问题”，所以指老鼠出现在唐宁街。

evidence.quote: Rats were seen running around Downing Street.

q4.explanationZh: 第四段说 According to his official government page，说明政府网站上有 Larry 的专属页面。
